tools.name: find_business
tools.description: Looks up a local business by name and town and returns up to 5 matching Google Maps listings with place_id, address, rating, review count, coordinates and a link for writing a review. Use it to get the place_id or coordinates that the other tools need.

tools.name: check_negative_reviews
tools.description: Read-only. Reads the public negative Google reviews of one business, compares them with Google review policies and returns counts, the policy categories that matched and up to 5 short excerpts of flagged reviews. It only reads public data: nothing is posted, reported, changed or removed on Google, a

tools.name: check_local_rank
tools.description: Checks where a business appears in Google Maps results for one search phrase, searched from one point (latitude and longitude). Returns its rank, the number of results seen, and up to 5 competitors ranked above it with their ratings and review counts.

tools.name: email_removal_report
tools.description: Sends the written review-removal report for a business that was already checked with check_negative_reviews to an email address. Call only after the user has typed their own email address in this conversation. Sends one real email; it can send at most once per address and business per day.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_business, check_negative_reviews, check_local_rank · Public sink: email_removal_report · Destructive: check_negative_reviews.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_business, check_negative_reviews, check_local_rank · Public sink: email_removal_report · Destructive: check_negative_reviews

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_negative_reviews" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
